ambient_definitions.centralIndex: centralIndex n : Fin (gridSize(n+1)) is the natural index 2^n, valid because 2^n < 2^(n+1)
ambient_definitions.coefficientPolynomial: A_k = PowerSeries.trunc (k+1) (coefficientSeries k); equivalently A_k(t)=sum_(r=0)^k [sum_(m=0)^r binom(k+r-m,k)/m!]t^r
ambient_definitions.finite_index_convention: j=sum_(i=0)^n bit_i*2^i; grid includes its left endpoint and excludes its right endpoint
ambient_definitions.sampleNorm: Real.sqrt (sum j : Fin (gridSize N), (sampledAmplitude k N L j)^2)
ambient_definitions.smoothInitial: smoothInitial k p = if p < -1 then Real.exp p else if p ≤ 0 then (sourceInterpolant k).eval p else Real.exp (-p)
ambient_definitions.sourceInterpolant: taylor 1 (C(exp(-1))*endpointFactor k + (endpointFactor k).comp (1-X)); eval at p equals exp(-1)(1-t)^(k+1)A_k(t)+t^(k+1)A_k(1-t) with t=p+1

ambient_definitions.Cost: Op → ℕ; tick op q = if q=op then 1 else 0
ambient_definitions.Op: field | sqrt | angle | trig | compare | read | write | emit, all distinct
ambient_definitions.Run: Run α has value : α and cost : Cost; pure x = (x,0); bind x f computes y=f x.value and returns (y.value,x.cost+y.cost)
ambient_definitions.affinePoint: affinePoint origin step j = origin + step*(j:ℝ)
ambient_definitions.arithmetic: StoredGivens.add/sub/mul/div x y = charge field (x+y / x-y / x*y / x/y), respectively
ambient_definitions.below: below x = charge compare (decide (x < -1)), using exact ℝ comparison
ambient_definitions.charge: charge op x returns value x and cost tick op
ambient_definitions.compute: compute n L: width←mul Real.pi L; lower←sub 0 width; search n 0 lower width
ambient_definitions.cost_scope: only the declared exact-real operations; natural index arithmetic, powers of two, proofs and counter bookkeeping are outside this model. No finite-bit complexity claim.
ambient_definitions.cutIndex: Nat.ceil ((-1-(-Real.pi*L))/gridStep n L); natural ceil clamps below at zero. Search interval has 2^n cells from -pi*L to 0, including the excluded endpoint for cutoff purposes.
ambient_definitions.gridPointNat: gridPointNat n L j = affinePoint (-Real.pi*L) (gridStep n L) j
ambient_definitions.search_succ: search (r+1) start lower span: half←div span 2; middle←add lower half; yes←below middle; if yes then search r (start+2^r) middle half else search r start lower half
ambient_definitions.search_zero: search 0 start lower span: yes←below lower; pure (if yes then start+1 else start)

interfaces.signature:
theorem gridPointNat_lt_neg_one_iff (n : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (j : ℕ) :

interfaces.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBinaryCutoff.search_value
interfaces.signature:
theorem search_value (n remaining start : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hlo : start ≤ cutIndex n L) (hhi : cutIndex n L ≤ start + 2 ^ remaining) :
    (search remaining start (gridPointNat n L start)
      (gridStep n L * (2 : ℝ) ^ remaining)).value = cutIndex n L

interfaces.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBinaryCutoff.search_cost
interfaces.signature:
theorem search_cost (remaining start : ℕ) (lower span : ℝ) (op : Op) :
    (search remaining start lower span).cost op =
      2 * remaining * tick .field op + (remaining + 1) * tick .compare op

interfaces.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBinaryCutoff.compute_value
interfaces.signature:
theorem compute_value (n : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    (compute n L).value = cutIndex n L

interfaces.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBinaryCutoff.compute_cost
interfaces.signature:
theorem compute_cost (n : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (op : Op) :
    (compute n L).cost op =
      (2 * n + 2) * tick .field op + (n + 1) * tick .compare op
